venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='nan_ritt@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)

pending=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token,status='pending',page_index=i,page_limit=20)
    print('pending page',i,'len',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    pending.extend(page)
    # stop when last page is smaller than limit
    if isinstance(page,list) and len(page)<20:
        break
    i+=1
print('total_pending',len(pending))
print('first_pending_senders',[(p['payment_request_id'],p['sender']['name'],p['sender']['email']) for p in pending[:5]])

# Login to phone

phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='2307354647', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']

# Cache relationship determination by email
email_to_relationships={}

def get_relationships_for_email(email):
    if email in email_to_relationships:
        return email_to_relationships[email]
    rels=set()
    page_idx=0
    while True:
        results=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=email, page_index=page_idx, page_limit=20)
        print('search_contacts for',email,'page',page_idx,'len',len(results))
        if not results:
            break
        for c in results:
            for r in c.get('relationships',[]) or []:
                rels.add(r)
        if len(results)<20:
            break
        page_idx+=1
    email_to_relationships[email]=rels
    return rels

# Determine which pending requests are from roommates or coworkers
approved=[]
skipped=[]

for p in pending:
    sender_email = p['sender']['email']
    rels = get_relationships_for_email(sender_email)
    is_roommate = 'roommate' in rels
    is_coworker = 'coworker' in rels
    if is_roommate or is_coworker:
        approved.append(p)
    else:
        skipped.append(p)

print('approved_count',len(approved))
print('skipped_count',len(skipped))
print('approved_sample',[(p['payment_request_id'],p['sender']['name'],p['sender']['email']) for p in approved[:5]])
print('skipped_sample',[(p['payment_request_id'],p['sender']['name'],p['sender']['email']) for p in skipped[:5]])

# Verify complete_task API signature
import inspect
print('complete_task callable', apis.supervisor.complete_task)
try:
    # can't inspect signature easily; just show doc via api_docs
    print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name='supervisor', api_name='complete_task'))
except Exception as e:
    print('doc_error', e)

# Re-attempt approving all remaining pending Venmo payment requests, then complete the supervisor task.

# Login to Venmo
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='nan_ritt@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']

# Helper to fetch all pending payment requests

def fetch_pending():
    pending=[]
    i=0
    while True:
        page=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(
            access_token=venmo_token,
            status='pending',
            page_index=i,
            page_limit=20
        )
        print('pending page', i, 'len', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        pending.extend(page)
        if isinstance(page, list) and len(page) < 20:
            break
        i += 1
    return pending

pending_before = fetch_pending()
print('pending_before_count', len(pending_before))
print('pending_before_ids', [p['payment_request_id'] for p in pending_before])

# Approve each
